verdict.rationale: Docs confirm forwarding is initiated in-app/portal with a few taps rather than emailing support (docs-6, docs-26, docs-27), which covers the 'not through support' part of the story. However there's no evidence of saved recipient management, carrier choice selection, automated forwarding rules, or upfront cost display before confirming a forward. missing for 10: saved recipients feature, carrier selection at forward time, cost/price shown before confirmation, rule-based/automated forwarding triggers.
